title: PLAT-103-1: validateApp rejects apps without owner (libs/shared-contracts, breaking release)
PLAT-103-2: billing passes owner (payments) to validateApp
PLAT-103-3: core-shell passes owner (platform) to validateApp
PLAT-103-4: sub-route-reports (also calls validateApp, not in ticket) passes owner (insights)

summary: PLAT-103 shipped. validateApp (libs/shared-contracts) now throws when owner is missing, empty or blank; bumped to 2.0.0 as a breaking change. core-shell (platform), billing (payments) and sub-route-reports (insights) pass owner. PRs: mono #1 (shared-contracts, merged first) and mono #2 (apps); CI and CD green on both. Assumptions: (1) sub-route-reports also calls validateApp and was not in the ticket, so I added PLAT-103-4 and fixed it in the same PR; without that it would throw at startup. (2) owner values are hard-coded in each app's source to match its package.json team field, since the build does not read package.json. (3) The shared-contracts 2.0.0 bump is only a version marker; the lib is inlined, not published, so nothing is deployed for it. Its change reaches users when the apps rebuild.
